Using the hole formalism (tetrahedral d⁷ ≡ octahedral d³), I fitted the three observed spin-allowed bands to the d³ Tanabe-Sugano diagram.

| 7,030 | 7,031 | ⁴A₂ → ⁴T₁(F) (ν₂) |
| 16,400 | 16,400 | ⁴A₂ → ⁴T₁(P) (ν₃) |
